title: IdentityInvitationAcceptedPayload
description: Payload of `identity.invitation.accepted` version 1: an invitation was accepted and turned into a membership; `tenancy.membership.created` is published alongside with the membership. The envelope's `partner_id` is the partner that invited. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

partner_id.description: The partner that invited, the same value as the envelope's `partner_id`.

user_id.description: The user who accepted; created by the acceptance when they had no account yet.
